The Situation

Right now your bootcamp runs through a third-party platform. It works, but every member you sign up, every contact, every bit of history sits inside their system, not yours. You built the brand. You built the community. You show up every Sunday. Yet the customer list belongs to someone else.

The day they change their terms, raise their cut, or kill a feature, you have no say. You are renting access to your own people.

This proposal hands all of it back to you, inside the LFG website you already own.

What Gets Built

A full operating system for LFG bootcamps and membership, on your domain.

Bootcamp Booking Engine

Members pick a Sunday session and reserve directly on lfgdubai.com. Live capacity, sold-out states, automatic session rollover.

Secure Payments

Card, Apple Pay, and Google Pay through Stripe. Money lands straight in your account. No platform between you and your revenue.

Member Accounts

Every booker gets an account. See who they are, what they've paid, and how often they show up. On the LFG brand, not a generic portal.

LFG Merch Store

Sell tees, caps, and gear on your site with the same checkout. A new revenue stream you aren't running today, live from day one.
